summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Looksy fashion social media app. Backend APIs are fully functional with 100% success rate. Frontend UI loads correctly with proper theme changes, navigation, and user flows. Authentication system works via session tokens. All core features tested successfully including post upload, like system, comments, earnings calculation, and user profiles.
passed_tests: User management endpoints (get user, update category)
Image upload to GridFS and retrieval
Post CRUD operations (create, read, list by category)
Landing page with Google login button
Dashboard with three-tab navigation (All, Men/Spade, Women/Hearts, Stars)
Theme changes based on category (black for men, dark red for women, white for stars)
Upload post form with all fields (image, caption, music, location, venue, price, products)
User profile with earnings display (visible only on own profile)
